blocksHtml:
• Description
  • Product Table
  • Video

The Cambium Networks ePMP Force 300-25L is a cost-effective and high-performance wireless solution for long-distance PTP and PTMP deployments. Operating in the 5GHz spectrum, this radio delivers up to 400 Mbps throughput and features an integrated 25 dBi high-gain dish antenna, making it ideal for rural broadband expansion, CCTV backhauls, and remote connectivity across Bangladesh.

Built on the powerful 802.11ac Wave 2 platform, the Force 300-25L supports MU-MIMO, low latency, and high spectral efficiency. It’s a perfect choice for ISPs, WISPs, and enterprise networks requiring reliable connectivity with excellent price-performance.


Link Distance:

  • Maximum Line-of-Sight Distance: Up to 25+ km

  • Typical Reliable Link: 10–20 km (with clear LOS and good alignment)


Key Features:

  • Frequency: 5GHz (5150 – 5850 MHz)

  • Throughput: Up to 400 Mbps

  • Integrated 25dBi High-Gain Dish Antenna

  • Based on 802.11ac Wave 2 Technology

  • Point-to-Point and Point-to-Multipoint Compatible

  • TDD synchronization support

  • Rugged outdoor design (IP55-rated)

  • Simple alignment tools for easy installation
